summary: Backend-only validation of new /api/projects (Kanban Acompanhamento) module + iter116/117 P0 fix (auditor role authorized via _require_manager + core.is_super_admin). Wrote pytest suite covering CRUD, status transitions, checklist subtasks (done/undo + done_at/done_by_name), file upload (PDF + invalid mime + 10MB limit), download with Content-Disposition, cascade delete, activity feed event types, and RBAC (auditor allowed; colaborador 403). 35/35 tests PASSED on the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC on read endpoints is permissive: GET /api/projects, /stats, /{id}, /activity, /files/{id}/download are reachable by colaborador (verified in test_colaborador_can_list). Project requirement says 'colaborador apenas leitura', which matches current behavior — confirm this matches product intent. If projects should be assignee-scoped for colaborador, listing currently leaks all company projects to colab.

File storage uses base64 inside MongoDB documents (data_b64). 10MB limit OK, but heavy use (many files) will grow the projects collection quickly; consider GridFS or external object storage long-term.
Activity log uses best-effort try/except (good), but messages are not internationalized — fine for pt-BR product.
_normalize_project recomputes checklist_progress on every read — O(n) per project but n is small (<100 items typical). Acceptable.

MAX_FILE_SIZE check happens AFTER full file.read() — a hostile client uploading a 1GB file consumes server memory before the 413. Consider streaming/Content-Length pre-check for production hardening. Not blocking.

GET /api/projects sort is ('status', 1, 'created_at', -1) — alphabetical status ordering ('backlog' < 'em_andamento' < 'em_revisao' < 'finalizado' happens to work in PT-BR, but is fragile. Consider explicit status weight.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_iter117 and cleaned up at end of suite
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite test_iter117_projects_kanban.py is self-contained and idempotent (creates/cleans TEST_iter117_* projects). Uses PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env or falls back to current preview URL. Endpoints validated: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects, /stats, /checklist (CRUD + done/undo), /files (upload+download+delete with mime/size validation), /activity (event-type assertions for created/status_changed/checklist_added/done/undone/removed/file_uploaded/file_removed), cascade delete, and RBAC (auditor 200, colaborador 403 on create/patch).
rca of the issue: Previous P0 (auditor 403 on POST /api/projects) — confirmed FIXED. _require_manager in /app/backend/routes/projects.py now accepts roles gestor/administrador/auditor + is_super_admin via core.is_super_admin(). Auditor (role=auditor, not super_admin) successfully created/patched/deleted projects and managed checklist/files. Colaborador correctly receives 403 on write endpoints.
